info.title: PLEXUS Intelligence
info.description: The universal intelligence API. Any domain, any question — synthesized from the world's knowledge sources, payable per call in USDC.
info.x-long-description:
PLEXUS is the intelligence layer between raw data and decisions that matter.

Most APIs give you a database lookup. PLEXUS gives you a verdict. Query any entity, topic, or question and get back synthesized intelligence drawn from across the world's knowledge — regulatory records, court filings, scientific literature, financial data, legal databases, cultural archives, historical records, and more — in a single call.

INTELLIGENCE PRODUCTS
Scored, synthesized reports that combine multiple sources into a single 0-100 signal with per-source breakdown. Company risk, political exposure, supply chain screening, healthcare due diligence, nonprofit transparency. One call, one verdict.

DATA ADAPTERS
Direct normalized access to hundreds of data sources across government, science, law, finance, health, environment, history, and culture. Same interface, every source.

AI REASONING ENGINES
Proprietary cognitive tools built for agent pipelines: adversarial deliberation, quality scoring, claim verification, safety gating, gap detection, signal diversity analysis. The thinking layer your pipeline is missing.

TWO WAYS TO ACCESS
x402 protocol — pay per call in USDC on Base mainnet, no API keys, no accounts. Agents discover and pay autonomously.
RapidAPI — traditional subscription tiers for teams that prefer key-based billing.

Built by Silent Ampersand LLC.

post.description: Know if a company has regulatory problems before you do business with them. One call checks EPA violations, OSHA workplace safety, CFPB consumer complaints, federal court litigation, international sanctions, and corporate entity validation. Returns a 0-100 risk score, letter grade (A-F), per-signal breakdown, and specific flags. Replaces hours of manual compliance research with a 10-second API call.

example.summary: ExxonMobil has 1 risk signal across 6 sources. Score: 20/100 (B).
flags: Federal court presence (2,334 total matching cases)

post.description: Map any entity's political footprint in one call. Surfaces FEC campaign contributions, federal government contracts via USASpending, Federal Register regulatory mentions, and Congressional bill references. Returns a political exposure score with channel-by-channel breakdown. Essential for lobbying disclosure, political risk assessment, and government relations research.

example.summary: Lockheed Martin has political activity across 2 channels. Score: 30/100.

post.description: Screen a supplier before you sign the contract. Checks OSHA labor violations, EPA environmental compliance, SAM.gov federal debarment status, and FMCSA carrier safety ratings. Flags critical issues — debarment, unsatisfactory safety ratings, repeat violations. Built for procurement teams, vendor onboarding workflows, and supply chain compliance automation.

example.summary: FedEx shows no significant supply chain risk signals. Score: 0/100.

post.description: Verify a healthcare provider's credentials and risk profile in one call. Checks NPI registry (8M+ providers), CMS Medicare billing patterns, FDA drug adverse events, and CFPB consumer complaints. Returns credential verification status, billing activity summary, and risk flags. Built for credentialing, payer contracting, and healthcare M&A due diligence.

example.summary: Provider verified (NPI found). 3 FDA drug adverse events. Score: 24/100.

post.description: Get the real financial picture of any nonprofit before you donate, grant, or partner. Pulls IRS 990 data — revenue, expenses, assets — from the most recent filing, with automatic entity resolution to find the right org. Adds GLEIF corporate validation, CFPB complaints, and federal court litigation. Returns financials, risk flags, and a transparency score. Built for donor due diligence and grant evaluation.

post.description: Search Federal Election Commission records — 500K+ candidates, political committees, and contribution records. Find who's donating to whom, track PAC activity, and pull campaign spending data.

Check any US facility's environmental compliance record. Violations, inspections, emissions data, and enforcement actions. Search by company name, state, or ZIP. Essential for ESG screening and environmental due diligence.

Look up workplace safety records for any US employer. Inspection results, violation types, penalty amounts, and enforcement history. Critical for vendor screening, M&A due diligence, and labor compliance.
Pull SEC EDGAR filings by ticker symbol — 10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks. Built-in ticker-to-CIK resolution with 40+ pre-cached symbols.
Bureau of Labor Statistics — unemployment rates, CPI, employment by industry. Economic indicators for any US region or sector.
US Census demographics — population, income, housing, education statistics by geography. ACS 5-year estimates and decennial data.
Search the National Provider Identifier registry — 8M+ US healthcare providers by name, specialty, state, or NPI number. Returns credentials, taxonomy codes, practice addresses.
CMS Medicare provider payment data — reimbursement amounts, utilization patterns, and provider-level billing activity.
Search FDA adverse event reports, drug product labels, and recall notices. Track safety signals for any medication. Essential for pharmacovigilance and regulatory monitoring.
FDA food enforcement — recalls, market withdrawals, safety alerts for food products. Track contamination events and enforcement actions.
See what consumers are complaining about at any financial company. Complaint types, outcomes, narratives, resolution status. Early warning system for reputational and regulatory risk.
Search federal court records across every US jurisdiction. Opinions, dockets, and case search via CourtListener's 8M+ document corpus. Find litigation history for any company, person, or legal topic.
Look up any nonprofit's IRS 990 tax filing. Revenue, expenses, assets, executive compensation — automatically enriched with latest filing data and smart entity resolution.
Legal Entity Identifiers — corporate ownership, entity registration, and cross-border identification via the Global LEI Foundation.
FEMA disaster declarations — historical and current emergency management data for any US location. Track disaster patterns by state or type.
Vehicle recalls, consumer complaints, and safety investigations from NHTSA. Search by make, model, or year.
Development indicators — GDP, population, trade, health metrics for 200+ countries. Time-series economic data.
Real-time and historical seismic events worldwide. Magnitude, depth, location, and timestamp for every recorded earthquake.
Federal contract and grant data — track government spending by agency, recipient, or program via USASpending.gov.
Federal contractor registration, exclusions (debarment), and entity validation via SAM.gov.
Screen any person or entity against global sanctions lists, PEP databases, and watchlists. Covers OFAC, EU, UN, and 30+ national regimes. Critical for KYC/AML compliance.
Search proposed rules, final rules, and notices from the Federal Register. Track regulatory changes affecting any industry. Early warning for compliance teams.
Search 600K+ clinical studies by condition, intervention, sponsor, or keyword. Track trial status, enrollment, and results. Pharma competitive intelligence.
Look up any FDIC-insured institution — financials, branch locations, holding company structure, regulatory status.
Historical weather and climate observations from NOAA. Temperature, precipitation, severe weather by station or city name.
Search Congressional bills, resolutions, and legislative activity. Track legislation by topic, sponsor, or keyword.
Department of Education data — tuition, graduation rates, post-graduation earnings, admission rates for every US college.

The decision gate every AI pipeline needs. Classifies any claim into ASSERT (high confidence), PROBABILISTIC (hedge it), INVESTIGATIVE (research first), or REFUSE (below quality floor). Prevents your AI from asserting things it shouldn't.
Quantified quality scoring for AI outputs. Evaluates on 7 weighted axes: evidence, reasoning, calibration, source quality, domain fit, coherence, meta-cognition. Returns 0-1 composite score.

text.example: AI will replace all jobs by 2030

post.description: Multi-perspective AI deliberation. Advocate, critic, and analyst roles examine a question from competing angles, then synthesize a verdict. Structured adversarial reasoning as a service.

question.example: Should we invest in quantum computing?

post.description: Should your AI agent take this action? Assesses recoverability, blast radius, downstream consequences. Returns PROCEED, GATE, or BLOCK with a recoverability score. The safety layer for autonomous agents.

Generates the strongest possible counterargument to any position. Not a gentle devil's advocate — finds the most credible, evidence-based challenge. Built for red-teaming and defeating confirmation bias.

position.example: Remote work is always more productive

post.description: Finds what should be known but isn't. Identifies missing information, prediction errors, and knowledge gaps — ranked by importance with research warrants. The investigative instinct your AI is missing.
Fact-check any claim with evidence chains. Returns verdict (true/false/unverifiable), confidence score, and evidence chain. The trust layer between your AI's output and your user.
Anti-groupthink for AI pipelines. Feed multiple AI responses — identifies dominant views, dissenting opinions, blind spots, injects novel perspectives. Detects and defeats convergent AI behavior.
Entropy-minimizing model dispatch. Given a task, recommends optimal routing — DIRECT, CASCADE, TRIBUNAL, or PARALLEL — with model selection and cost estimates.
Deliberative Assembly Protocol — PASS/WARN/FAIL/RECOVER gate decisions for AI pipeline outputs. Quality assurance for autonomous workflows.
Operational mode detection: CRISIS, DEEP_WORK, ROUTINE, RECOVERY, EXPLORE — with transition probabilities and recommended actions. Adaptive system profiling.
Intelligent web extraction — HTML parse with optional LLM schema extraction. Pull structured data from any webpage. No headless browser required.
